page.overview:
Who is Denis Villeneuve?

Denis Villeneuve is the director and a writer and producer of the films Dune: Part One, released in 2021, Dune: Part Two, released in 2024, and Dune: Part Three, released in 2026. He is also an executive producer of the spin-off series Dune: Prophecy, and was originally set to direct the pilot episode.

Villeneuve will not be involved in Dune 4. According to Villeneuve, he never intended to direct a Dune film beyond Dune: Messiah, as he feels that the quality of Frank Herbert's works dropped after the second novel.

Villeneuve is known for his work directing Blade Runner 2049 (2017), Arrival (2016), Incendies (2010), and Sicario (2015).

Also known as: Villeneuve.
